_notes.source: Founder's full name (Paul Jon Siljee Jr.) confirmed via WebSearch (X/Instagram/TikTok handles, a TradeZella blog post); no separate official website found, only social profiles, so 'website' points to the Whop page. 10% affiliate commission confirmed via whoptrends.com during our earlier shortlist research. Review count shown (2,500) is from the live Whop page directly, more recent than whoptrends.com's cached 1,651 figure from the same research pass. The community's own promo banner lists prop-firm discount partners including one labelled 'Alpha' — a YouTube video title confirms this is Alpha Futures, NOT Alpha Funded (which we list separately), so we named it explicitly to avoid the mix-up CLAUDE.md warns about. No Trustpilot profile found. Logo cropped from the community's own Whop banner wordmark.
